docs.title: Microlensing context, on demand
docs.text:
Nancy is a shared, searchable knowledge base for microlensing software, documentation, tutorials, notebooks, and literature. Connect it to an MCP-capable assistant and ask questions in the environment where you already work.

:material-connection: Connect from VS Code :material-console: Connect from Codex

docs.title: What you need
docs.text:
1. An invite code from the Nancy administrators.
  2. A personal Nancy API key.
  3. An MCP client that supports Streamable HTTP and custom authentication headers.

Request your personal key once:

curl -X POST https://mcp.rges-pit.com/v2/api-keys/request \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"invite_code":"YOUR_INVITE_CODE","contact":"you@example.com"}'

The response contains api_key. Store it as a password: do not commit it to a repository, paste it into a shared configuration file, or post it in Slack.

Already using the old address?

https://nancy-brain.malpas.nz remains supported. The RGES-PIT address is an additional stable name for the same service.

docs.title: What Nancy can do
docs.text:
• Search the microlensing knowledge base semantically.
  • Retrieve precise passages with source and line metadata.
  • Explore indexed document and repository trees.
  • Apply personal retrieval weights to prioritize useful sources.
  • Report service and index status.

Nancy exposes knowledge-base tools, not a language model. Your chosen AI client decides how to use the returned evidence and generates the answer.

docs.title: Building your own knowledge base
docs.text: This site documents the shared microlensing service. To build, configure, or self-host a different knowledge base, use the Nancy Brain package documentation.

docs.title: HTTP API
docs.text:
The same service exposes a small HTTP API for scripts and diagnostics.

export NANCY_MCP_API_KEY="YOUR_PERSONAL_KEY"

docs.title: Search
docs.text:
curl -G https://mcp.rges-pit.com/search \
  -H "X-API-Key: ${NANCY_MCP_API_KEY}" \
  --data-urlencode "query=annual microlensing parallax" \
  --data-urlencode "limit=5"

docs.title: Retrieve
docs.text:
curl -X POST https://mcp.rges-pit.com/retrieve \
  -H "X-API-Key: ${NANCY_MCP_API_KEY}" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"doc_id":"DOCUMENT_ID","start":1,"end":80}'

docs.title: Tree
docs.text:
curl -G https://mcp.rges-pit.com/tree \
  -H "X-API-Key: ${NANCY_MCP_API_KEY}" \
  --data-urlencode "prefix=microlensing_tools" \
  --data-urlencode "depth=3"

docs.title: Health
docs.text:
curl https://mcp.rges-pit.com/health

The health endpoint is public. Search, retrieval, tree, weighting, SQL, and rebuild operations require authentication.

docs.title: Operators
docs.text: This page deliberately contains only safe operational entry points.

docs.title: Service endpoints
docs.text:
Service Address Hosted documentation https://nancy.rges-pit.com MCP and HTTP API https://mcp.rges-pit.com Health check https://mcp.rges-pit.com/health

The administrative interface is restricted to service operators and is not part of the public user workflow.

docs.title: Privacy and acceptable use
docs.text:
Nancy processes search terms, document identifiers, and tool arguments sent by your MCP client. Operational records may include an API-key prefix, IP address, timestamp, and request metadata for reliability and abuse prevention.

  • Do not send secrets, unpublished participant data, or sensitive personal information in queries.
  • Your MCP client and model provider process the conversation under their own policies.
  • Treat retrieved material according to its source license and collaboration rules.
  • Personal API keys may be revoked if shared or abused.

Nancy does not sell usage data. To request key revocation or deletion of associated records, contact amber@malpas.nz.

For implementation and self-hosting behavior, see the Nancy Brain package documentation.

docs.title: Tools
docs.text: Nancy provides five primary MCP tools.

docs.title: Search
docs.text: Semantic retrieval across indexed software, documentation, notebooks, and papers. Start broad, inspect results, and retrieve the strongest sources.

docs.title: Retrieve
docs.text: Read a source document or a bounded line range. Retrieved results include stable document identifiers and provenance metadata.

docs.title: Tree
docs.text: Explore indexed paths without requiring the original raw repository checkout. Both short indexed paths and the historical knowledge_base/raw/ prefix are accepted.

docs.title: Weight
docs.text: Apply a personal multiplier from 0.5 to 2.0 to influence subsequent search ranking. Weighting is useful when a toolkit, tutorial, or paper is especially authoritative for your work.

docs.title: Status
docs.text: Inspect service health and index metadata. This is the first diagnostic when search results appear stale or the tools stop responding.

docs.title: Good agent instructions
docs.text:
Tell your assistant to search before answering, retrieve the relevant passages, and cite source paths. For example:

Search Nancy for finite-source point-lens parallax fitting. Retrieve the most relevant tutorial and implementation passages, then answer with source paths.

docs.title: Claude Code
docs.text:
Claude Code supports remote HTTP MCP servers with custom headers. Set the key in your environment:

export NANCY_MCP_API_KEY="YOUR_PERSONAL_KEY"

Add this user-scoped entry to Claude Code:

claude mcp add --scope user --transport http \
  nancy-microlensing https://mcp.rges-pit.com/mcp \
  --header "X-API-Key: \${NANCY_MCP_API_KEY}"

Inside Claude Code, run /mcp to verify the connection.

docs.title: Claude.ai and Claude Desktop
docs.text:
Claude's remote connector interface currently supports authless and OAuth servers. Nancy currently uses personal API keys rather than a complete MCP OAuth flow, so the hosted service cannot yet be added directly through Settings > Connectors.

Do not put the API key in the connector URL. Use Claude Code, VS Code, Codex, or another client that supports custom request headers until OAuth support is available.

docs.title: Codex
docs.text: Codex can connect directly to Nancy using a bearer token. Nancy accepts the same personal key through either Authorization: Bearer or X-API-Key.

docs.title: Add the server
docs.text:
Store the key in your shell environment:

export NANCY_MCP_API_KEY="YOUR_PERSONAL_KEY"

Then register Nancy:

codex mcp add nancy-microlensing \
  --url https://mcp.rges-pit.com/mcp \
  --bearer-token-env-var NANCY_MCP_API_KEY

Restart Codex if it is already open.

docs.title: Verify
docs.text:
codex mcp list

Then ask Codex:

Search Nancy for finite-source point-lens parallax fitting examples.

Environment persistence

Shell exports last only for that shell session. Put the variable in your preferred secrets manager or shell startup configuration if you want it available after a reboot. Never commit the key.

docs.title: Other MCP clients
docs.text:
Use these connection values in any client that supports Streamable HTTP and custom headers:

Setting Value Transport Streamable HTTP MCP URL https://mcp.rges-pit.com/mcp Header name X-API-Key Header value Your personal Nancy API key

Nancy also accepts:

Authorization: Bearer YOUR_PERSONAL_KEY

docs.title: Minimal protocol check
docs.text:
A plain browser request to /mcp is not a valid MCP session. It should return 401 without a key. Use an MCP client or the official MCP Inspector for a full protocol test.

The unauthenticated health endpoint is:

curl https://mcp.rges-pit.com/health

docs.title: VS Code
docs.text: VS Code can connect directly to Nancy over Streamable HTTP.

docs.title: Add the server
docs.text:
Run MCP: Open User Configuration from the Command Palette and add:

{
  "inputs": [
    {
      "type": "promptString",
      "id": "nancy-api-key",
      "description": "Nancy API key",
      "password": true
    }
  ],
  "servers": {
    "nancy-microlensing": {
      "type": "http",
      "url": "https://mcp.rges-pit.com/mcp",
      "headers": {
        "X-API-Key": "${input:nancy-api-key}"
      }
    }
  }
}

Start nancy-microlensing from MCP: List Servers. VS Code prompts for the key without storing it in the JSON file.

docs.title: Verify
docs.text:
Open Chat in agent mode and ask:

Use Nancy to find tutorials about annual microlensing parallax.

The tool-call details should show a Nancy search followed by one or more retrieval calls.

docs.title: Troubleshooting
docs.text:
• 401 Invalid or missing API key: re-enter the personal API key.
  • Server unavailable: check service health.
  • No Nancy tools: run MCP: List Servers, select the server, and inspect its output log.
